name_reason: Conforms to data_fd2_battle_<descriptor>: 'visibility_table' correctly reflects both the array data type (table) and the verified purpose (per-slot visibility/enable mask). The '8slot' is a domain descriptor for the 8-slot summon-spell orbit animation family (the sibling y_offset and row_multiplier tables share it; the frame-counter array inits 8 slots via i in 0..7), not a Ghidra address residue. No hex address fragment in the name. Verified against disasm at 0x26152 (MOVZX read, state-4 CMP EDX,1 / state-5 TEST EDX,EDX gates).
purpose: Per-slot visibility/enable mask for the summon-spell stage-0 'pre-animation' 8-slot orbit setup; selects which slots are drawn in the visible pass (state 4) vs the inverse pass (state 5).
logic_summary: 7-byte const mask copied wholesale (MOVSD/MOVSW/MOVSB) into a stack buffer by fd2_tick_summon_spell_setup_pre_animation_8slot @ 0x26152, then read back per slot via MOVZX (zero-extended uint8, stride 1, index = slot 0..6). In state 4 (BLIT-IF-VISIBLE) a slot is blitted only when mask==1 (CMP EDX,1); in state 5 (BLIT-IF-HIDDEN) only when mask==0 (TEST EDX,EDX). mask==1 marks the front group (visible in pass 4, hidden in pass 5); mask==0 is the opposite. Values {0,0,1,0,1,0,0} => slots 2 and 4 are the visible-pass group.
element_semantics: Each element = one slot's boolean visibility selector (0 or 1). 1 = drawn in the state-4 visible pass and hidden in the state-5 inverse pass; 0 = the opposite. Read zero-extended (MOVZX), stride 1, indexed by slot 0..6.
comment_original_issue: The main comment block (lines 532-550) was accurate and precise. The trailing one-liner '/* Non-const: read-only in-game, but mutated by anisumm1 test fixtures. */' was stale and self-contradictory: it said 'Non-const' while the declaration is 'const uint8', and it framed const-ness around test fixtures (which the const-data policy forbids). Confirmed const by Ghidra: only [READ] + [DATA] xrefs from 0x26152, zero game-side writers; the anisumm1 fixtures that wrote it are already SKIP-gated for Phase 3 rewrite (globals.h declares it extern const).
notes: Array is genuinely 7 entries (uint8[7]); the '8slot' in the name refers to the orbit animation family (8 staggered frame counters in data_fd2_battle_summon_spell_shared_15slot_frame_counter_array, state-3 init i in 0..7), while the visibility/y_offset/row_multiplier copies and blit loops run 7 slots (0..6). Sibling stale 'Non-const' one-liners exist on the y_offset/row_multiplier/job_crit tables too but were left untouched per the one-symbol-only rule.
